# acetaminophen - label, indications, targets 
## FDA Label 
 
### Indications and Usage 
Uses temporarily: reduces fever relieves minor aches and pains due to: the common cold flu headache sore throat toothache 
## Targets (ChEMBL / Open Targets) 
PTGS1, PTGS2, TRPV4, FAAH, TRPV1 
## Indications (Open Targets) 
 
Allergic rhinitis, Arthritic Pain, Backache, Common cold, Fever, Headache disorder, Alzheimer disease, Nasolacrimal duct obstruction, subarachnoid hemorrhage (Phase 3), malaria (Phase 3), Myalgia, stroke disorder 
More:
  biomcp get drug acetaminophen approvals   - Drugs@FDA approval history
  biomcp get drug acetaminophen regulatory --region us   - approval and supplement history; use only if the base card lacks approval context
  biomcp get drug acetaminophen safety --region us   - regulatory safety detail; use `biomcp drug adverse-events <name>` first when you want post-marketing signal

All:
  biomcp get drug acetaminophen all --region us
